name: PagerDuty V1
description: The Sumo Logic App for PagerDuty V1 collects incident messages from your PagerDuty account via a webhook, and displays that incident data in pre-configured Dashboards, so that you can monitor and analyze the activity of your PagerDuty account and Services. The Sumo Logic App for PagerDuty V1 uses Webhooks V1.

panels.name: Incidents Triggered
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/PagerDuty "incident.trigger"
| json "messages[0].type", "messages[0].data.incident.id", "messages[0].data.incident.created_on", "messages[0].data.incident.status", "messages[0].data.incident.urgency", "messages[0].data.incident.assigned_to[0].object.name", "messages[0].data.incident.escalation_policy.name", "messages[0].data.incident.service.name"  as type, incident_id, created_on, incident_status, incident_urgency, assigned_user, escalation_policy_name, service_name
| where type = "incident.trigger"
|count by type

panels.name: Type of Incidents
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/PagerDuty 
| json "messages[0].type", "messages[0].data.incident.id", "messages[0].data.incident.created_on", "messages[0].data.incident.status", "messages[0].data.incident.urgency", "messages[0].data.incident.assigned_to[0].object.name", "messages[0].data.incident.escalation_policy.name", "messages[0].data.incident.service.name"  as type, incident_id, created_on, incident_status, incident_urgency, assigned_user, escalation_policy_name, service_name

| count by _timeslice , type
| transpose row _timeslice column type

panels.name: Top Alerting Services
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/PagerDuty assigned_to "incident.trigger"
| json "messages[0].type", "messages[0].data.incident.id", "messages[0].data.incident.created_on", "messages[0].data.incident.status", "messages[0].data.incident.urgency", "messages[0].data.incident.assigned_to[0].object.name", "messages[0].data.incident.escalation_policy.name", "messages[0].data.incident.service.name" as type, incident_id, created_on, incident_status, incident_urgency, assigned_user, escalation_policy_name, service_name
| json field=_raw "messages[0].data.incident.trigger_summary_data.description" as incident_descrition nodrop
| where type = "incident.trigger" 
| count by service_name
| order by _count
